scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exactly the fifteen finite levels 1 through 15, all ordered directed distances in unweighted accelerated-edge units
scientific_integrity.evidence: Complete breadth-first exploration of every source vertex, at most 32768 vertices and 2^30 ordered pairs; two separate compiled implementations and an additional tuple-state checker to level nine
limitations: No all-level, asymptotic or eventual-stabilization conclusion
Accelerated-edge lengths differ from physical symbolic-shift time
Bibliographic priority cannot be guaranteed beyond inspected literature

title: Exact directed-distance profiles of the first fifteen accelerated Kolakoski Schreier graphs
